unit_of_analysis.primary: completed event in logs/steps.jsonl with tool_name in agent_message, command_execution, file_change, plus task.started/task.completed
unit_of_analysis.excluded: thread/turn bookkeeping events and tool_start events to avoid double-counting started/completed pairs
unit_of_analysis.primary_process_rule: exactly one primary process label per included event, selected by deterministic analytic priority
unit_of_analysis.secondary_attribute_rule: zero or more orthogonal attributes may attach to any primary process label

primary_process_labels.label: orientation
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent establishes task/workspace context before implementation.
primary_process_labels.include: Initial context checks, scaffold checks, prompt-to-workspace framing.
primary_process_labels.exclude: Concrete file/tool inspection commands, which are inspection.

primary_process_labels.label: inspection
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent gathers information from files, tools, commands, or the local environment.
primary_process_labels.include: Workspace reads, source reads, git status, toolchain discovery, package-cache checks.
primary_process_labels.exclude: Strategic change after a constraint, which is adaptation.

primary_process_labels.label: planning
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent states or selects an implementation strategy.
primary_process_labels.include: Messages describing intended architecture, file layout, endpoint design, or next coding step.
primary_process_labels.exclude: Final summaries and factual command output.

primary_process_labels.label: implementation_writing
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent creates, updates, or deletes source/configuration artifacts.
primary_process_labels.include: File-change events that add, update, or delete implementation artifacts.
primary_process_labels.exclude: Later correctness repairs explicitly triggered by review or failure, which are refinement.

primary_process_labels.label: refinement
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent revises code after initial construction for correctness or robustness.
primary_process_labels.include: Fixes to validation, status codes, edge cases, persistence, routes, build errors, or tests.

primary_process_labels.label: verification_static
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent runs formatting, lint, syntax, or source-level checks.
primary_process_labels.include: gofmt, py_compile, syntax-only compilers, tsc --noEmit, source-level checks.
primary_process_labels.exclude: Full project builds, tests, and live service probes.

primary_process_labels.label: verification_build
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent builds or compiles the generated project.
primary_process_labels.include: go build, cargo build, npm run build, tsc project build, javac/gcc/g++ project checks.
primary_process_labels.exclude: Unit tests and live HTTP probes.

primary_process_labels.label: verification_test
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent runs an automated test suite or local test command.
primary_process_labels.include: pytest, unittest, go test, npm test, jest, vitest, rails test, rspec, phpunit.
primary_process_labels.exclude: Build-only commands and manual curl probes.

primary_process_labels.label: verification_runtime
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent starts or probes live runtime behavior.
primary_process_labels.include: Server startup, curl/http requests, runserver, port binding, endpoint smoke tests.

primary_process_labels.label: failure_observation_diagnosis
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent observes, records, or explains an error, failed command, or mismatch.
primary_process_labels.include: Failed verification, missing-tool output, traceback/error output, explanatory diagnosis messages.
primary_process_labels.exclude: Successful verification and ordinary implementation work.

primary_process_labels.label: adaptation
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent changes strategy in response to constraints or failed assumptions.
primary_process_labels.include: Fallback to standard library, local compatibility layers, dependency replacement, cache relocation.
primary_process_labels.exclude: Minor code fixes that do not alter strategy.

primary_process_labels.label: final_reporting
primary_process_labels.definition: The agent summarizes completed work, validation, artifacts, or residual limitations.
primary_process_labels.include: Final assistant message and task.completed records.

secondary_attribute_labels.label: defensive_coding
secondary_attribute_labels.definition: The behavior concerns security- or robustness-relevant implementation choices.
secondary_attribute_labels.include: Input validation, path normalization, SQL parameterization, escaping, size limits, secret handling.
secondary_attribute_labels.exclude: Generic implementation work without defensive relevance.

secondary_attribute_labels.label: dependency_related
secondary_attribute_labels.definition: The behavior concerns package, framework, compiler, module, or runtime dependencies.
secondary_attribute_labels.include: Dependency discovery, module-cache checks, missing framework diagnosis, package fallback.
secondary_attribute_labels.exclude: General workspace inspection unrelated to dependencies.

secondary_attribute_labels.label: environment_or_sandbox_constraint
secondary_attribute_labels.definition: The behavior concerns constraints imposed by the local environment or sandbox.
secondary_attribute_labels.include: Blocked network, missing binaries, permission errors, unwritable caches, bind/socket denial.
secondary_attribute_labels.exclude: Ordinary application bugs not caused by the environment.

secondary_attribute_labels.label: runtime_service_constraint
secondary_attribute_labels.definition: The behavior concerns live service startup, HTTP probing, process lifetime, or port binding.
secondary_attribute_labels.include: curl probes, runserver behavior, socket bind failures, background process checks.
